description.value:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This potion is a melody in clear liquid form, with little musical notations swimming and darting through it like fish. You gain the Songburst action for 1 hour after you imbibe this concoction.

Songburst 1 (auditory, sonic) You vocalize a high-pitched melody that deals @Damage[4d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] (@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] save). A creature that fails the saving throw is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Deafened] for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure). After you use Songburst, you can't do so again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge do so]]{1d4 rounds}.
